# Test fixtures

`pre-ski-listener*/`: TLS-listener chains exactly as releases before the SKI/AKI change wrote them, generated by that commit's `src/x509.js`. `test/ca-key-identifiers.test.js` checks that such a chain is reissued.

**The private keys here are throwaway test material**, generated for this repository on 2026-10-08. They sign nothing anyone trusts and are not used by any deployment. Never reuse them.
